name: Ensemble ~Maioriru Hane no Ensemble~
original_name: ENSEMBLE～舞降る羽のアンサンブル～
source: Fifteen years ago, Hiyoshi Kaede got separated from his sister after the divorce of his parents. They planted a maple tree on their house's garden as a way to remember each other. Now, he returns to the tree once again...
translation: 十五年前，日吉枫因父母离婚与妹妹分离。兄妹二人在自家庭院里种下一棵枫树，作为彼此的纪念。如今，他再次回到了这棵树下…
